title: Homotopy exact sequence for proper flat families with geometrically connected reduced fibres
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: The proof constructs an adjoint to pullback on finite etale covers using Stein factorization, rather than merely applying abstract exactness. A cover with one trivial geometric fibre component must be shown to equal the pullback of its Stein factor by a degree-one argument on a connected scheme.
